name: Ford Motor
notes: Revenue = total company sales and revenues incl. Ford Credit. operatingIncome = Ford's 'Operating income' (total revenues less total costs and expenses; interest on Automotive and Other debt, other income and equity income below it), reported from 2017 (first shown in the FY2019 10-K, 2017-2018 on the same basis). Earlier years carry no consolidated operating income line and are derived (quality estimated) on the same definition: 2011-2016 as total revenues less total costs and expenses of the consolidated income statement; 2000-2010 as Automotive sector operating income (reported) plus Financial Services revenues less costs (the sector's income before taxes where it has no other lines). 2005 excludes the Hertz sale gain. Discontinuities: from 2017 non-service pension cost sits outside operating income (2016 on the new basis would be 5,786 instead of 4,116); 2006-2007 revenue and 2000-2004 figures are as restated in later 10-Ks (discontinued operations, Volvo and Jaguar Land Rover sales). Not comparable with GM and others whose segment definitions differ.
